## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36622 @ 78acf16996 (head of record, full sha on the PR; `main` merged by the relay's update-branch onto f4425f440e after #36619's fix PR #36636 merged) · card #36591 · L1 first read by area s2-B (area order rule 9) · 2026-11-23T06:41Z · no contract review owed (`Clause-②: no`: no new export, no new key)

- **Shape:** open, draft, base `main`; first line `Fixes #36591`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; no closing keyword near another card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36622` CLEAN).
- **Premise:** held (claim 7090287287). The sidebar sorts each navigation level by `order` (`byNavOrder`); design mode listed and saved array order, so in an app whose entries carry `order` a saved move changed nothing on screen.
- **Scope:** 7 files, 337+/6-: `designModeMenuModel.ts` (`inShownOrder` through the existing `inMenuOrder`; `withOrderRewritten`), `designModeMenuSave.ts` (sort the stored menu before `rebaseMenuEdits`, rewrite `order` after), `DesignModeMenu.tsx` (seed in shown order), three existing test files, one changeset. Not governed. The update-branch delta leaves the PR's own diff byte-identical (same 7 files, same stat).
- **Diff read:** the route is the claim's (rewrite `order`, never drop it): a level where any entry carries `order` gets every entry numbered `0..n-1` in shown order, groups and their children per level; a level with no `order` is saved by array order and gains no key. `order` is never a patch key in the rebase, so nothing is read as a conflict or dropped.
- **Changeset** read against the diff: matches; patch per `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Tests and gates:** new pins in the three #36363 harnesses, the sidebar read from a rendered `NavigationRenderer` (move up, add after + move to group, mixed level, two no-`order` controls). Ablation (rewrite removed): 6 red, both controls and the display pin green; restore blob equal to HEAD. 38 of 38 derived gate families run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Browser: NOT MEASURED (reason in the PR body; the sidebar half is measured through the real renderer). CI at 78acf16996: 39 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing (the earlier head f4425f440e was red twice only on #36619, readings 7091578823 and 7091810932; fixed by PR #36636).
- **Accepted deviations:** renumbering rewrites authored values on any save of an `order`-carrying level (`10, 20, 30` → `0, 1, 2`); the drawn order is unchanged. Accepted as the card's chosen route.
- **Out of scope:** `navigationContributions` from other packages keep their own `order` and are not renumbered (no live app found with one); Studio's `AppNavCanvas` writes `order` on the moved entry only. Both Acceptance notes, not filed.
- **Landing:** non-governed, ≤3000 lines; K = 1 (<15) at this head ⇒ area lands it in this stroke; s2-C #36606 rebases on it after the merge.
